subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 The value of 4 in 342 is 40. The value of 2 in 342 is 2. Can you count backwards from 342 to 337? 342, 341, 340, 339, 338, 337. Practice Questions 602 Hundreds Tens Ones 602 = _______ hundreds, _______ tens and _______ ones In expanded form, 602 = ________+ ________+ ________ The digit 6 in 602 is in ____________ place. The digit 0 in 602 is in ____________ place. The digit 2 in 602 is in ____________ place. The value of 6 in 602 is ____________ . The value of 0 in 602 is ____________ . The value of 2 in 602 is ____________ . Count backwards from 602, _______, _______, _______, 598. Count forward from 602, _______, _______, _______, 606, Numbers are not just digits; they have names too! Let's learn how to say and write them. 4
